TD-10 fix: SidecarClient state is std::atomic with a Starting state; startAsync runs the connect on a worker thread joined in stop()/dtor.
C++<->sidecar transport: WinHTTP client + CreateProcess in a Job Object (KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE) so no orphan; Windows system libs only, no vcpkg dep (ADR-035's HTTP choice).
Authorized running the local ComfyUI Metric3D model (execute code + torch.load weights) and installing open3d/addict/yapf into Python 3.11 — the sidecar's own out-of-build deps.
QM-057 confidence = planar-quality x verticality gate (floor/ceiling -> ~0) x ambiguity gate, so the gallery floor-trap returns LOW confidence instead of confidently wrong.
Metric3D: call the package's internal predict_depth_normal() for RAW metric depth; its public __call__ returns a colormapped depth (loses scale).
ChArUco asset written 3-channel (a grayscale PNG loads as GL_RED -> red-on-black).

lessons: A success-metric-critical refactor stays safe when the editing path is index-based: swapping the uniform N x N model for a non-uniform control grid left drag/Tab-cycle/arrow-nudge untouched.

Make new geometry math testable by extracting it as a pure static (QuadGeometry::inverseBilinear) instead of a UI-TU file-static — forward-then-inverse round-trip tests catch sign/ordering bugs the smoke harness can't.
Temporary env-gated visual demos (QM_SOFTEDGE_DEMO / QM_UVGRID_DEMO / QM_GRIDDEMO) are an honest way to screenshot-verify a visual feature, then remove the scaffolding (git keeps nothing).

lessons: Metric depth (Metric3D) fixes the spike's affine bow on oblique surfaces; call predict_depth_normal() for raw metric depth (public __call__ returns colormapped).
A verticality prior (1 - |normal_y|) as a multiplicative gate makes the 'largest plane != intended surface' floor-trap return low confidence instead of confidently wrong.

One-Flash = detect the SAME ChArUco in the projector reference + the photo, match by marker id, findHomography — avoids board-unit bookkeeping; synthetic warped-pattern test validates the solve with zero hardware.
A grayscale PNG loads as a single GL_RED channel (renders red-on-black) — write calibration patterns 3-channel.

ImGui menu-driving for verification is unreliable (foreground-steal, moving window, DPI fonts); a guarded headless self-test hook (env-gated) is the robust, honest way to watch a feature work end-to-end.
